observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa 10 minutong tabletop, ayusin ang prayoridad, handover, continuity, follow-up at suporta sa responder.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, in a 10-minute tabletop, sequence priorities, handover, continuity, follow-up and responder support.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Gumagamit ng di-kumpirmadong contact, walang follow-up o iniiwang walang kapalit ang pagod na volunteer.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses unconfirmed contacts, skips follow-up or leaves the exhausted volunteer without relief.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Inuuna ang ligtas na paglikas, may unang ligtas na aksiyon, kumpirmadong lead at follow-up ang bawat isyu, at may kapalit ang volunteer, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Puts safe evacuation first, gives each issue a first safe action, confirmed lead and follow-up, and arranges relief for the volunteer, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naaayos ang mga isyu ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa pagtatala ng pagtanggap, follow-up o kapalit ng volunteer.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Orders the issues but needs a prompt to record acknowledgement, set follow-up or relieve the volunteer.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Gumagamit ng di-kumpirmadong contact, walang follow-up o iniiwang walang kapalit ang pagod na volunteer.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses unconfirmed contacts, skips follow-up or leaves the exhausted volunteer without relief.
